title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.4 with Native Computer-Use
snippet: OpenAI has officially released GPT-5.4, introducing native support for computer-use abilities within Codex, allowing AI agents to operate directly across desktop applications.

title: Anthropic Unveils Claude Cowork for macOS
snippet: Anthropic brings agentic capabilities to everyday work with Claude Cowork, a dedicated platform for OS X that helps users manage complex, multi-step workflows autonomously.

title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Now Dominates Benchmarks
snippet: Google's latest Gemini 3.1 Pro update has taken the lead in 13 out of 16 major performance benchmarks, solidifying its position as a powerhouse for deep reasoning tasks.

title: DeepSeek V4: The 1 Trillion Parameter Giant
snippet: DeepSeek has released V4, a massive 1-trillion parameter model featuring a tiered KV cache for ultra-fast inference and sparse FP8 decoding for efficiency.

title: Nvidia Reveals 'Vera Rubin' Next-Gen GPU Platform
snippet: At GTC 2026, Nvidia unveiled its new AI factory platform designed to support trillion-parameter models and physical AI simulations at massive scales.

title: Meta Signs $27B Infrastructure Deal with Nebius
snippet: Meta has secured its AI future with a monumental five-year agreement for cloud infrastructure to power its next generation of research into autonomous systems.
